title: NetworkMeConsentAppsResult
description: network.me-consent-apps-result@1 (the consent plan's C4, 2026-11-07): "Apps you allowed" on the signed-in person's account page. GET /api/v1/me/consent/apps on OpenVibe.Network. It lists every app the person granted a purpose to on its sign-in screen (consent:<purpose>, network.consent-claim@1), with the purposes granted and those refused in the last 30 days. It also carries the words the app consent screen shows for each purpose. Only the person's own session reads it; an app never sees this list, its own entry included.

purposes.description: The purposes an app may ask for, with the exact words the app consent screen shows.

allows.description: What ticking it allows the app, in one plain line.

cannot_undo.description: What turning it off later cannot undo (empty when nothing).

adults_only.description: Ticking it asks the person to confirm they are 18 or older.

apps.description: One entry per app with a purpose granted or refused, apps with an active grant first, then by name.

name.description: The app's name as its developer (or OpenVibe, for its own sites) registered it.

third_party.description: True for a developer's app (app_<ULID>), false for an OpenVibe site.

granted.description: The purposes the app holds now (active network.consent@1 records with this client).

quiet.description: The purposes the person refused this app in the last 30 days: the app does not ask for them again until quiet_until. DELETE /api/v1/me/consent/:purpose/:client/refusal ends that early, so the next sign-in asks.
